name: Ridge Motorsports Park

reference_lap.notes: Synthetic centerline at 1m resolution built from median across 258 clean drift-corrected laps. Replaces the recorded-reference-lap approach because every recorded lap has localized GPS issues somewhere. See data/corpus/ridge_centerline.parquet.

_seed_lap_for_centerline_build.notes: Used as initial seed reference to build the synthetic centerline. Clean against all Maps pins (max 7.91m). Not used for ongoing labeling.

_previous_reference_lap.notes: Retired 2026-05-10. Inner-loop GPS glitch confirmed via Google Maps pinning.

_calibration_anchors_notes: All anchor coords are Google Maps satellite-derived visual-apex (kerb-touch) locations. Aggregation across anchors uses median for robustness. Previous May-1-derived anchor coords retired 2026-05-10 — they were biased by May-1's specific GPS recording errors (T2 anchor was 55m off truth, T14 was 30m off, T13 happened to be within 2m).

corners.notes: Fast L sweeper. Apex 441 m at 89 mph, 0.67 g (verified from 2026-05-01 lap 3, 2:04.4). No brake / minimal lift before turn-in; brake comes for T2.
Slow L. Apex 621 m at 60 mph, 1.04 g (verified 2026-05-01 L3). Brake-on around 640 m for the T1+T2 sequence.
Apex 695 m at 60 mph, 0.84 g (verified 2026-05-01 L3).

T4 + T5 driven as one long left — hold the wheel, car takes a set. Apex 790 m at 68 mph, 0.79 g (verified 2026-05-01 L3). Visual apex precedes lat-G peak (~831 m) by ~41 m, consistent with the fast-power-on offset seen at T1.
See T4. Apex 917 m at 77 mph, 0.93 g (verified 2026-05-01 L3). Brief R lat-G shift around 1080 m as the car straightens before T6 setup — not a numbered corner.

corners.name: Carousel
corners.notes: Long L sweeper. Typical entry ~1237 m at 104 mph, 0.47 g (verified 2026-05-01 L3); earliest entry seen is 1142 m. Heavily line-dependent: driven double-apex, constant-radius, or decreasing-radius. apex_m (1392 m, ~56 mph) is the heavy-load / slowest-speed point from cluster data — typically the trail-in apex. secondary_apex_m (1528 m, 66 mph, 1.01 g, verified L3) is the racing-line / 'actual' apex per the driver — second of the double-apex line.

Slight R going down the hill at near-WOT. Apex 1694 m at 89 mph, 0.72 g (verified 2026-05-01 L3). Detected lat-G peak around 1745 m (cluster G₁) is the trail-out of T7 / hand-off to T8 — visual apex precedes lat-G peak by ~51 m, same as T1. Detection window overlaps T8 because lat-G stays loaded continuously through T7→T8.

Long R with multiple lines. apex_m (1862 m, ~50 mph, 1.0 g) is the heavy-load / slowest-speed point from cluster data — the trail-in apex. secondary_apex_m (1941 m, 60 mph, 0.84 g, verified 2026-05-01 L3) is the racing-line / 'actual' apex per the driver.
WOT going up the hill. Apex 2111 m at 89 mph, 0.78 g (verified 2026-05-01 L3). Visual apex precedes lat-G peak (2144 m) by ~33 m — fast-power-on offset.
WOT continuing up the hill. Apex 2365 m at 104 mph, 0.88 g (verified 2026-05-01 L3). Speed climbs through here toward T11 brake zone.
Hard L. Apex 2600 m at 41 mph, 0.98 g (verified 2026-05-01 L3).
Apex 2804 m at 46 mph, 0.98 g (verified 2026-05-01 L3).
Slowest corner of the lap. Apex 3247 m at 29 mph, 0.90 g (verified 2026-05-01 L3). Start of the slow back-section chicane (T13-T14-T15).
Apex 3303 m at 37 mph, 0.83 g (verified 2026-05-01 L3).

Visual apex 3363 m at 51 mph, 0.41 g (verified 2026-05-01 L3) — driver notes the car continues to rotate past this point. Speed minimum is around 3397 m and lat-G peak around 3419 m, so the rotation tail extends ~50 m past the racing-line apex.
Last corner; opens onto the front straight back to start/finish. Apex 3495 m at 66 mph, 0.39 g (verified 2026-05-01 L3) — light corner, brief lat-G load.
